note: Light trigger check set: should-trigger phrasings about a company's customers after the sale (onboarding, success, renewals, support, the knowledge base, the voice of the customer) and about the user as a customer (complaints, returns, refunds, warranty claims, subscriptions), and near-miss negatives a neighbouring department owns, phrased close to this one's. Used by the description trigger check.
should_trigger: onboard our new customer Acme, what should their first month look like
which of our accounts are at risk of churning before renewal
prep the renewal review for our biggest account
triage these support tickets for me
draft a reply to this angry customer whose export keeps failing
what are our customers telling us this quarter
turn this resolved ticket into a knowledge base article
set response time SLAs for our support team
build a customer health score for our accounts
the same bug keeps coming in from different customers, what do we do
write a complaint to my airline about my lost luggage
help me return these shoes, the store says it's past 30 days
my laptop stopped charging after eight months, make a warranty claim
cancel my gym membership, they keep making it hard
go through my subscriptions and tell me which ones to cut
the store refused my refund for a broken blender, what do I do next
the contractor botched our bathroom and won't answer, get me a refund or a redo

near_miss.query: this customer wants a 15% discount to renew, should we give it
write the test plan for the export bug our customers keep hitting
our helpdesk tool keeps dropping tickets, fix the integration
my new laptop won't connect to the Wi-Fi, help me set it up
the outage is all over social media, draft our public statement
write a glowing review of the restaurant we loved for their website
design an interview study on why our users churn
build a support chatbot into our React app
chart our monthly churn rate from this spreadsheet
should we shut down our free tier
a customer asked us to delete all their personal data under GDPR, what must we do
can I sue the contractor in small claims court for the botched job
build me a monthly budget that includes all my subscriptions
plan my Saturday errands: the post office, the pharmacy and a returns drop-off
find and book a plumber to fix the leak under the sink this week
